helpers.what: LSD line segment detector, #included by ashift.c:101; finds straight lines for automatic structure detection. Not a module.
Nelder-Mead simplex optimiser, #included by ashift.c:105; fits rotation, lens shift and shear for the fit buttons. Not a module.

controls.label: lens model

controls.label: focal length

controls.label: aperture
controls.note: editable combobox (f-number); default from EXIF

controls.label: distance

modules.notes: Defaults for camera, lens, focal, aperture, distance and crop are taken from EXIF in reload_defaults (lens.cc:3436); params.has_been_set=FALSE means gui_update copies the image defaults back in. The Lensfun page needs searchable camera/lens pickers and editable focal/aperture/distance comboboxes, not sliders. Sections 'fine-tuning' and 'manual vignette correction' are collapsible; their sliders get action prefixes 'fine-tune/' and 'vignette/' via DT_IOP_SECTION_FOR_PARAMS_DECL (lens.cc:4504, 4582). Not one-instance: multiple instances are allowed. A 'corrections done' label reports what Lensfun actually applied.

modules.name: rotate and perspective
modules.purpose: Straightens a tilted horizon and fixes converging lines, for example leaning buildings.

controls.label: rotation
controls.note: displayed = -param; soft range ±10° (ROTATION_RANGE, ashift.c:53); already in controls.h

controls.label: focal length
controls.note: log curve slider; default from EXIF focal length, 28 mm if missing (ashift.c:5681)

controls.label: crop factor
controls.note: default from EXIF crop factor (ashift.c:5685)

controls.label: lens dependence
controls.note: always hidden in the GUI; leave out of Omalux

controls.label: aspect adjust
controls.note: log2 curve slider

controls.label: rectangle
controls.note: draw a perspective rectangle on the image (structure row)

controls.label: lines
controls.note: draw structure lines on the image

controls.label: auto
controls.note: detect line structure automatically (uses ashift_lsd.c)

custom_widgets.what: draw lines or a rectangle along edges that should be straight
right-drag a line on the image to set the horizon

modules.notes: Helpers, not modules: ashift_lsd.c (LSD line segment detector, #included at ashift.c:101) finds straight lines for 'structure/auto'; ashift_nmsimplex.c (Nelder-Mead simplex optimiser, #included at ashift.c:105) solves rotation/lens shift/shear for the 'fit' buttons. Params cl/cr/ct/cb (crop box), last_drawn_lines and last_quad_lines are written by on-canvas interaction only. Omalux exposes only 'rotation' today; the fit buttons need structure first (auto detection, drawn lines or a rectangle) so they are a two-step image action. One instance only. Right-drag on the image defines a horizon.

modules.name: crop
modules.purpose: Cuts away the edges of the photo to improve the framing or change the aspect ratio.

controls.label: aspect
controls.note: editable: user may type x:y or a decimal; list is sorted most-square first and extended from config plugins/darkroom/clipping/extra_aspect_ratios; quad button flips orientation; ratio_n/ratio_d default -1 = last used

controls.label: right
controls.note: displayed = 100 - 100*cw (right margin)

controls.label: bottom
controls.note: displayed = 100 - 100*ch (bottom margin)

custom_widgets.what: drag the frame and its edges on the image

modules.notes: Defaults come from the image's usercrop (crop.c:888), normally 0/0/1/1. Sliders call set_digits(4) before set_format('%'), which subtracts 2 (bauhaus.c:3327), so they display 2 decimals; display.json records the pre-subtraction 4. Margins sit in a collapsible 'margins' section without an action prefix (controls.h uses 'left'/'right'/'top'/'bottom'). Omalux already maps these four plus an on-canvas crop overlay; the aspect combobox is missing. One instance only; shortcut 'c'.

modules.name: crop and rotate
modules.purpose: Old combined crop, rotate and keystone tool, kept only so older edits still open.

controls.label: flip
controls.note: not a param field: encoded as the sign of cw (horizontal) and ch (vertical), clipping.c:2027

controls.label: keystone
controls.note: custom combobox; keystone points kxa..kyd are set on-canvas

controls.label: aspect
controls.note: same editable aspect list as crop

custom_widgets.what: drag the crop frame and keystone corners; right-drag to straighten

modules.notes: IOP_FLAGS_DEPRECATED (clipping.c:370): darktable hides it from new edits; replaced by crop + rotate and perspective + orientation. Recommend: do not expose; only preserve when an imported history uses it. Notebook action 'page'.

modules.name: orientation
modules.purpose: Turns the photo in 90 degree steps or mirrors it.

controls.label: rotate 90 degrees CCW
controls.note: shortcut [

controls.label: rotate 90 degrees CW
controls.note: shortcut ]

modules.notes: Single enum param 'orientation' (dt_image_orientation_t, common/image.h:134; -1 autodetect = use EXIF, 0 none, 1 flip vertically, 2 flip horizontally, 4 transpose, 3/5/6/7 combinations). Buttons XOR bits relative to the current or EXIF orientation (flip.c:540-594); the 'transform' reset label resets to autodetect. Enabled by default (flip.c:485). One instance. Buttons, not sliders.

modules.name: rotate pixels
modules.purpose: Internal step that straightens the diagonal sensor layout of some old Fujifilm cameras.
modules.notes: IOP_FLAGS_HIDDEN (rotatepixels.c:73), no gui_init; params rx, ry, angle (-45°) set automatically from image->fuji_rotation_pos (rotatepixels.c:343). Never expose.

modules.name: scale pixels
modules.purpose: Corrects images from cameras whose pixels are not square, so the photo is not stretched.
modules.notes: Not flagged hidden, but only meaningful for a few sensors; the pipe disables it when the ratio is 1 (scalepixels.c:262). One instance. Recommend: hide in Omalux (or show only when the raw needs it).

modules.name: enlarge canvas
modules.purpose: Adds an empty border around the photo, for example to make room for a frame or a square crop.

controls.label: color
controls.note: no $DEFAULT, so 0 = green

modules.notes: hard max 100 so '%' keeps factor 1. flags() (enlargecanvas.c:91) returns IOP_GROUP_EFFECT | IOP_GROUP_EFFECTS, which as flag bits means ALLOW_TILING | ONE_INSTANCE: a darktable quirk, effectively one instance. No single 'primary' slider: four margins of equal weight.

modules.name: raw chromatic aberrations
modules.purpose: Automatically removes colored fringes along edges, working directly on Bayer raw data.
modules.notes: Only for Bayer raws with 3 channels; otherwise the GUI shows a label and the module cannot be enabled (cacorrect.c:1253). One instance. Essentially an on/off module.

modules.name: chromatic aberrations
modules.purpose: Removes colored fringes along high-contrast edges on any image.

controls.label: radius
controls.note: soft range is set in reload_defaults (cacorrectrgb.c:706)

modules.notes: Section label 'advanced parameters' is cosmetic (no action prefix). Multi-instance useful (e.g. a 'darken only' pass).

modules.name: defringe
modules.purpose: Older tool that hides purple or green fringes by desaturating edges.
modules.notes: flags() has no IOP_FLAGS_DEPRECATED, but default_group() ORs IOP_FLAGS_DEPRECATED (1<<2) into the group mask (defringe.c:88), which only adds the 'color' group bit; so it is NOT deprecated in darktable 5.6.1. Lab, display-referred; cacorrectrgb is the modern replacement. Multi-instance allowed.

modules.name: haze removal
modules.purpose: Removes fog and haze to bring back contrast and color in distant parts of the scene.

controls.label: strength
controls.note: negative values add haze

modules.notes: Params compatibility_mode and adaptive (hazeremoval.c:68-69) have no GUI widget. Straight slider mapping.

modules.notes: Two notebooks: RGB channel tabs (action 'channel') and Y0/U0V0 tabs (no action), only one visible depending on color mode (denoiseprofile.c:3055). The wavelet curves are the real controls in wavelet modes; Omalux already has a curve editor for Y0/U0V0. In 'auto' modes radius/scattering/shadows/bias are derived from the profile and overshooting. Mode 'compute variance' shows measured variance labels instead of controls. Multi-instance allowed (common: separate luma/chroma instances with blending).

image_actions: compute capture sharpen radius from raw data
modules.notes: Four comboboxes share the param demosaicing_method and the label/action 'method'; only the one for the current sensor is visible (demosaic.c:1540). Enum value 'AMaZE (dual)' has a stray quote in its $DESCRIPTION (demosaic.c:64). 'capture sharpen controls' is a collapsible section, no action prefix. Mandatory for raws, cannot be switched off (hide_enable_button, demosaic.c:1488); FENCE, one instance. For Omalux: capture sharpen (toggle + radius/iterations) is the user-relevant part; method choice is advanced.

modules.name: raw black/white point
modules.purpose: Sets the sensor's black and white levels so the raw data starts from the right zero and maximum.

controls.label: flat field correction
controls.note: default 'embedded GainMap' when present (rawprepare.c:770)

modules.notes: All defaults come from the raw file (rawprepare.c:761). Enable button hidden; enabled automatically when needed. Black levels are uint16 array entries whose label is overridden to 'black level N' (rawprepare.c:893). Technical: hide in Omalux except perhaps an expert panel. One instance.

modules.name: sharpen
modules.purpose: Makes edges crisper with a classic unsharp mask.
modules.notes: All three already in controls.h (sharpen_amount/radius/threshold) with matching ranges and digits. GUI order is radius, amount, threshold.

modules.name: diffuse or sharpen
modules.purpose: A physics-based tool that can sharpen, blur, add local contrast, bloom or dehaze, mostly driven by its presets.

controls.label: radius span
controls.note: already in controls.h as diffuse_radius

modules.notes: Section labels are cosmetic (no action prefixes). Digits: speed and anisotropy sliders call set_digits(4) then set_format('%'), so darktable shows 2 decimals (bauhaus.c:3330); sharpness set_digits(3) -> 1; display.json records the pre-subtraction values. Hard max <= 10 so '%' implies factor 100 for speed, anisotropy, sharpness and threshold. Omalux 'diffuse_opacity' is the blend opacity, not a module param. The module is meaningful mostly via its many presets; 15 raw sliders are expert-level. Multi-instance common.

modules.name: contrast equalizer

controls.note: chroma boost; y[4] chroma noise threshold

controls.label: edges
controls.note: edge halo control

controls.label: mix
controls.note: scales all curve points away from/towards default (atrous.c:657); stored in params

custom_widgets.what: drag points to change contrast per detail size; scroll changes the noise threshold curve

modules.notes: The curves are the real controls; 'mix' is the only slider. Many generic presets (clarity, sharpen, denoise, bloom, deblur...) at atrous.c:752-905 are the practical way to expose it as plain controls. Param 'octaves' has no widget. Notebook action 'channel'.

modules.name: legacy equalizer

modules.name: old local contrast

modules.name: highpass
modules.purpose: Keeps only fine detail; mainly used with a blend mode for sharpening or creative effects.
modules.notes: Output is a grey detail layer; useless without a blend mode (e.g. overlay/soft light). Omalux would need blend-mode control to make it useful.

modules.name: lowpass
modules.purpose: Blurs the image; with blend modes it gives soft-glow or local-contrast effects.
modules.notes: Params 'order' and 'unbound' have no widget. Usually combined with blend modes; multi-instance relevant.

modules.name: surface blur
modules.purpose: Smooths flat areas while keeping edges, for skin or noise.
modules.notes: Param 'reserved' has no widget. Straight slider mapping.

modules.name: blurs

controls.note: run time grows with radius squared

modules.name: censorize
modules.purpose: Pixelates and blurs areas such as faces or license plates for privacy.
